title: 22.8% efficient silicon solar cell
lineage: Inspected the original page reproduced in coauthor Martin Green’s 6 March 2015 UNSW presentation; the ANU repository also exposes the original abstract.

passages.locator: p. 1363, facsimile on the two slides titled First paper PERC solar cell (1989)
passages.note: The paper names the authors and the Solar Photovoltaic Laboratory at UNSW, Kensington. It describes a passivated emitter and rear cell and reports independently verified conversion efficiency up to 22.8%. The paper gives manuscript receipt on 9 May 1989, acceptance on 18 July and issue publication on 25 September. The reproduced section diagram depicts an insulating rear oxide and discrete rear contacts.

file.representation: paraphrased research notes and selected factual observations
